description:
A medical scientist needs to quantify fluorescence intensity in heterogeneous tumor cell clusters. Open the loaded image (~/Fiji_Data/raw/analysis_image.tif) and use the ROI Manager to define at least 6 distinct regions of interest (ROIs) around different cells or clusters. Use a mix of tool types: at least 2 ellipses, 2 rectangles, and 2 freehand selections. 

Configure measurements to include Area, Mean gray value, Standard deviation, Min/Max, Integrated density, and Median. Set the image spatial calibration to 0.65 microns/pixel. 

Measure all ROIs and export the following to ~/Fiji_Data/results/roi_analysis/:
1. 'roi_measurements.csv': The results table saved as CSV.
2. 'roi_set.zip': The set of ROIs saved from the ROI Manager.
3. 'annotated_overlay.png': An image showing the ROI outlines (flattened/overlay).
4. 'summary_report.txt': A text file reporting the number of ROIs, the mean fluorescence intensity (average of means), the coefficient of variation (CV) of the means, and identifying which ROI had the highest mean intensity.

All output files must be saved in ~/Fiji_Data/results/roi_analysis/.
